title: Low-Cal Spicy Kung Pao Tofu
subtitle: with Chinese Broccoli and Noodles
description: For our latest trick, we've made this scrumptious stir-fry low in calories! With colourful veggies, flavourful tofu, slippery noodles and a punchy sauce, it's absolutely magic.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Trim the Chinese broccoli, then cut into 5cm lengths, keeping the leaves and stems separate. Thinly slice the capsicum and spring onion. Quarter the tofu pieces. Put half the sriracha, 2 tbs soy sauce, 3 tsp white vinegar and 1 tsp sugar in a bowl and whisk to combine.
Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 7 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking. Cover to keep warm.

Warm tofu: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 1-2 mins each side until golden and warmed through. Add 1 tbs sauce mixture and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until the sauce is thickened. Remove from the pan and wipe the pan clean.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over high heat (see Kitchen 101). Stir-fry the broccoli stems, capsicum and Chinese barbecue seasoning for 2 mins or until the veggies are tender but still with crunch. Add the broccoli leaves and 1 tbs water and stir-fry for 1 min or until wilted.

Serve up: Add the glazed tofu and remaining sauce mixture to the veggies and stir-fry for 1-2 mins until warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the noodles and tofu mixture among bowls, scatter over the spring onion and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Want to know the secrets to stir-fry perfection? Have everything prepped and ready to go before you start cooking. And fast and hot is key: make sure you cook over high heat, stirring constantly so everything is cooked evenly.
